name: Firm Tiedend
description: The Warrior holds both rods in matched guard before the chest, the school's first posture.

name: Squall Fliparound
description: One rod drops and the other follows at once, the first lesson of paired striking.

name: Nimble Backspin
description: Each step falls as one rod falls, so hands and feet move on the same beat.

name: Dauntless Octastick
description: The rods change hands mid-swing, so the second blow arrives from the side the opponent has just guarded.

name: Thrallwhirr
description: The cord drops over the wrist and the pair of rods pull it into a lock.

name: Squalldowel
description: One rod parries and the other returns the beat upon the attacker's rib.

name: Pulsar Capstick
description: Both rods fall like a hammer upon an anvil and break through the guard laid between them.

name: Noble Stickend
description: Two rods sweep opposite ways at hip height and strike all who stand close by.

name: Sigil Cascade
description: Both rod tips tap two meridian points of the arm together and lock its qi flow.

name: Gripstick Triumph
description: The school's paired rods run guard, bind and strike along two tracks like channels of a river meeting in one blow.

name: Braced Hardstick
description: The rods circle slowly about the user, gathering the space within their orbits into a guarded court.

name: Clackbanner
description: Whoever steps into the court is cut at once by the nearer rod.

name: Deft Shoulderroll
description: The user's stride matches the orbit's turn so that the court moves with him.

name: Parity Roundstick
description: A parry rolls from one orbit to the next, passing the force around the court.

name: Fearless Swingstick
description: Both orbits draw inward together, pressing the opponent into the court's center.

name: Taut Sidespin
description: A loop flung from the nearer orbit settles over an opponent's weapon arm.

name: Imperious Cordjoint
description: A slap against an opponent's own orbit breaks its rhythm and its weapon's path.

name: Parity Chainjoint
description: A deflection gathers the opponent's force into the orbit, then flings it back along the cord.

name: Wrenching Stickend
description: Orbits close to a single ring about one opponent, so they cannot step beyond it.

name: Prism Neckwrap
description: Both orbits are driven together on one point and break through a defence.

name: Ruling Octastick
description: Orbit tips tap three points on the opponent's body, shutting their circulation for a short time.

name: Valiant Entropy Fliparound
description: The school's gathering move folds both orbits into a single court that strikes and binds all inside it.

name: Rodtroth
description: The user crouches above a sunk line, rods back like wings and eyes on the target ground.

name: Inferno Cascade
description: A cut sweeps round the rim of an imagined bowl and lands on the opponent's outer arm.

name: Vigorstave
description: Gliding forward with knees bent, the user stays beneath the opponent's guard line.

name: Rodseal
description: A loop cast about the rim of the opponent's reach closes inward upon the arms.

name: Squall Gripstick
description: A drop from height parries the blow and delivers the answer in the same movement.

name: Millstone Roundstick
description: Rods fall again and again from above, pressing the opponent down into the low ground.

name: Vigor Neckwrap
description: A cut along the rim shears at the opponent's wrist and shin together.

name: Radiance Backspin
description: The cord is carried on a deep plunge from above that passes through a guard.

name: Stavetroth
description: A ring of cords laid on the ground closes upon those who step inside it.

name: Pulsardowel
description: The user vanishes from the rim and lands inside the opponent's reach with a crossing strike.

name: Season Cordjoint
description: The school's closing move drops from height, circles the rim with the cord and ends in a binding strike.

name: Prismdowel
description: A broad, calm stance gives each rod its own court and the body a seat between them.

name: Clackedict
description: A heavy cut from the hinge lands with the full weight of a Ruler's arm.

name: Bedrock Shoulderroll
description: Paced strides keep the rods' two courts always in front of the user.

name: Bedrock Tiedend
description: One rod rules the center line and the other presses the flank, forcing the opponent back.

name: Millstone Swingstick
description: A weapon that enters the court is pinned by the rods and held there.

name: Squall Chainjoint
description: The courts reverse at a step, turning the blow aside and answering from the opened side.

name: Vacuum Fliparound
description: Both rods fall from either side like pincers and pass through a guard.

name: Inferno Hardstick
description: The rods sweep the whole court at once and strike every opponent within it.

name: Retribution Cordjoint
description: A pair of strikes at shoulder and wrist locks the opponent's arm and its qi.

name: Tiedend Banner
description: The school's ruling move holds both courts at once, trading guard and strike until the opponent is fixed.

name: Undefiled Stickend
description: The user stands tall and still, qi spreading as a field in which both rods float.

name: Quenched Capstick
description: A wide cut reaches across the whole field to the opponent's far shoulder.

name: Ethereal Backspin
description: The user steps to whatever point of the field is empty of threat.

name: Venerable Octastick
description: A stroke from any side is met by the nearest rod and shunted out of the field.

name: Imperial Shoulderroll
description: Orbits turned from above press the opponent's guard down one finger-width at a time.

name: Commanding Swingstick
description: A cord cast across the field snares the opponent's weapon hand.

name: Nightmare Neckwrap
description: A staring feint at one point makes the opponent guard it while the other rod lands elsewhere.

name: Venerable Capstick
description: A blow turned aside is answered with a plunge from above the rod's circle.

name: Entropy Hardstick
description: The rods sweep a ring through the whole field and strike every foe within it.

name: Quenched Roundstick
description: All of the field's attention is gathered into one plunge that goes through a raised guard.

name: Seasonrod
description: The user crosses the field in an instant and hits from the opponent's blind side.

name: Peerless Vacuum Gripstick
description: The school's central move gathers the whole field's attention and falls on a single point with both rods.

name: Undaunted Chainjoint
description: With the core settled, the user holds both rods in a guard that draws qi evenly.

name: Clackcrown
description: A cut fed directly from the core lands with a ring of steady qi.

name: Vigor Swingstick
description: Each foot follows its own track from the core, lightly and without waste.

name: Thrall Stickend
description: A thread of core qi runs the cord's length and binds whatever it touches.

name: Parityclack
description: Both rods parry on a pulse from the core, throwing a heavy blow wide.

name: Haemal Neckwrap
description: The rod rebounds twice from the same target, each beat driven by a pulse from the core.

name: Bedrock Gripstick
description: Two orbits turned from the core wear an opponent's guard down at a steady pace.

name: Heroic Sidespin
description: Core qi lights the rod's tip and drives it through a guard and the arm beyond.

name: Parity Capstick
description: The cord is run round the user in a ring fed from the core, tangling those who enter it.

name: Sigilwhirr
description: A pulse from the core sent through the rod tip locks the opponent's meridians at the touch.

name: Volition Roundstick
description: The school's central move passes core qi through cord and both rods in a running chain of bind and strike.

name: Steady Cordjoint
description: Feet set as on bare plateau, the user holds the rods in an even guard facing the wind.

name: Doweldecree
description: The rod falls along the bearing the student swore and lands on the opponent's guard arm.

name: Quickclack
description: The student reads the gust on the cheek and places each step to match it.

name: Octastick Covenant
description: Standing true to the oath, the rod meets a blow and holds its line unmoved.

name: Thunderclap Cascade
description: A swing timed on a gust travels faster and harder than its arm could drive it.

name: Millstone Shoulderroll
description: The cord is cast along a bearing and snags the opponent's weapon hand.

name: Gloom Tiedend
description: Swings on the wind press the opponent backward along the plateau.

name: Stavebanner
description: The rod falls from height along the sworn bearing and breaks a guard.

name: Raking Chainjoint
description: A wide orbit along the plateau's edge strikes everyone close by and drives them toward the drop.

name: Stavevow
description: Tips of the rods rap sworn points on the opponent's arm and lock its qi flow.

name: Symphonic Volition Cascade
description: The school's founding move holds one bearing through a chain of parry, bind and strike against the strongest gust.

name: Consecrated Hardstick
description: Facing the rising gale, the user sets the rods in a guard on a single fixed bearing.

name: Sidespin Crown
description: The rod is dropped from a gust's crest and falls straight onto the opponent's arm.

name: Feather Backspin
description: The user slides along the bearing line against the gale without losing the heading.

name: Paritystave
description: Keeping the heading, the rod turns a blow aside and sends back its answer.

name: Thrallstave
description: The cord, thrown on the gale, hooks the opponent's weapon arm from beyond reach.

name: Seasonclack
description: Orbits held on one heading press the opponent steadily backward through the gale.

name: Noble Backspin
description: With the gale at the back, the rod falls with doubled force through a raised guard.

name: Imperial Fliparound
description: The rods sweep one wide circle along the bearing and strike everyone in reach.

name: Ruling Gripstick
description: Rod tips tap the opponent's arm at two points on the heading and lock its qi.

name: Resonant Season Octastick
description: The school's move keeps one bearing through every gust while the rods run guard, bind and strike.

name: Sacrosanct Roundstick
description: The cord is held in an oath's posture, one end in each fist, before the chest.

name: Paramount Capstick
description: A cast along the bearing lands the rod on the opponent's shoulder at full reach.

name: Wraithlike Chainjoint
description: The user walks with the gale at the back and lets it speed each pace.

name: Pealstave
description: The cast rod returns upon the cord and meets a stroke on its way back.

name: Sigil Stickend
description: The cord, set swinging on the gale, loops about an opponent's arms.

name: Vigorclack
description: The orbit swings on the oath's heading and lashes the opponent from behind the guard.

name: Unbending Shoulderroll
description: A hard recall of the cord pulls the opponent's weapon out of line.

name: Vaunted Cordjoint
description: The cord's repeated casts along one heading press the opponent step by step.

name: Storied Fliparound
description: After a full wind-up the rod is cast on the gale and goes through a defence.

name: Thralldowel
description: The cord is thrown wide and closes as a ring around the opponent's whole body.

name: Sigilrod
description: Tips locked on the bearing tap the opponent's wrist and shoulder and shut their qi flow.

name: Tenet Sidespin
description: The school's move casts the sworn cord on a bearing and the gale returns it carrying the opponent's guard.

name: Faithful Hardstick
description: The user faces the wind squarely with both rods before the body and elbows tucked.

name: Quenched Tiedend
description: The windward rod leads, cutting across and drawing the opponent's guard to that side.

name: Windborne Cascade
description: Long even strides carry the user across the plateau with the rods in time.

name: Deluge Swingstick
description: The rod nearest the wind lifts to parry before the blow's course is certain.

name: Sigil Neckwrap
description: The leading rod hooks the opponent's wrist and the trailing one pulls the cord tight.

name: Parity Stickend
description: Rods trade the lead in a step, turning a blow and landing the answer from the other side.

name: Hardstick Verdict
description: Leading each exchange, the user's swings press the opponent toward the lee side.

name: Radiance Fliparound
description: The windward rod rises and plunges through the guard on the wind's push.

name: Unrivaled Gripstick
description: Both rods sweep a round upwind and strike all who stand close to the user.

name: Sigil Sidespin
description: The leading rod taps the shoulder, the trailing rod the wrist, and the arm's qi stops.

name: Orchestral Sidespin
description: The school's move has both rods lead in turn against the wind, ending with a bind and a strike.

name: Statute Capstick
description: The bearer stands with qi spread outward in a field and the rods sworn to circle freely within it.

name: Vigorwhirr
description: One full sworn orbit ends in a cut that arrives from the bearer's chosen angle.

name: Deluge Cordjoint
description: Each step follows the open orbit's turn, giving the bearer free movement in every direction.

name: Staveseal
description: An orbit answers each stroke with a parry at the point of contact.

name: Ruling Roundstick
description: The cord, carried on the wind, settles about the opponent's weapon arm.

name: Tiedend Crown
description: Sworn orbits press the opponent into a smaller and smaller space.

name: Storied Neckwrap
description: The orbit climbs and drops through a guard in one unbroken fall.

name: Magma Backspin
description: The whole sworn orbit sweeps outward and strikes every foe within its reach.

name: Pulsar Swingstick
description: The bearer vanishes from one point of the orbit and arrives at another with a strike already landing.

name: Symphonic Season Shoulderroll
description: The school's move binds each swing of the open orbit to the oath, ending in a single decisive blow.

name: Bedrock Octastick
description: With the core settled, the user lets the wind move through the rods held in even guard.

name: Steelrod
description: A cut powered by the core and carried on the gale lands with double the force.

name: Clackgrace
description: Core qi lightens the foot and the wind lifts each stride a little farther.

name: Sacrosanct Gripstick
description: Rods meet a blow with a pulse of core qi and a push of wind, throwing it wide.

name: Thrallclack
description: Qi from the core runs along the cord as it hooks the opponent's weapon arm.

name: Bedrock Capstick
description: The rod rebounds on the gale from the first strike and lashes a second time.

name: Famed Backspin
description: Orbits fed by the core and held on one heading press the opponent back.

name: Rodvow
description: A recall of the cord with a pulse of core qi snatches the opponent's weapon off its line.

name: Pulsarwhirr
description: The rod's tip is lit by core qi and plunges through a guard on the push of the gale.

name: Statute Chainjoint
description: A ring of cord is cast on the wind and tangles all that step into it.

name: Sigilclack
description: A pulse of core qi passed through the rod tip locks the opponent's meridians at the touch.

name: Harmonious Destiny Roundstick
description: The school's move joins core qi and gale in every swing of a running chain of bind and strike.
